message.reasoning:
The user message is: "Run the RSI strategy on SPY itself. Compare the strategy with buying and holding SPY over the same dates."
I ran the RSI mean-reversion strategy on SPY over the September 10, 2025–September 9, 2026 window with a $1,000 starting capital. The strategy bought when RSI(14) dropped below 30 and sold when it climbed above 70, with no fees or slippage — it completed 4 round trips and finished with about $1,080.

Buying and holding SPY over the same period delivered roughly $1,140. So the buy-and-hold approach beat the RSI strategy by about 5 % in this specific test.
